review.notes: Clean document: no patches. All 7 physical pages were rendered (110 dpi) and read against the OCR markdown, plus a 300 dpi crop of the Distribution channel lists; extracted PDF text was token-diffed against the markdown with no content drops. Both opening title lines are genuine (cover p.1 'Gemini 3.5 Audio (Live Translate, Transcribe, Transcribe Live) / Model card' plus inner title p.2 '... — Model Card'). The Distribution section's mixed bullet markers (plain / \- / •) reflect OCR bullet-style noise over an otherwise complete and correctly ordered list; per review rules bullet style is not a defect class, so it was left unchanged. Unusual names were verified as printed: 'Gboard Rambler' (300 dpi crop of p.4) and 'Tracked or Critical Capability Levels (T/CCLs)' both match the source. The only page-1 raster image is the Google logo; the card prints no content figures.
